title: ICON：質量加權示蹤物與網格平均契約
titleEn: ICON: mass-weighted tracers and grid-average contracts
subcategoryTitle: 地球、流體與離散物理驗證
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「ICON：質量加權示蹤物與網格平均契約」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付空氣與示蹤物雙帳本、分區重組證據及乾濕基準對照。
summaryEn: Investigate ICON: mass-weighted tracers and grid-average contracts using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver separate air and tracer mass ledgers, partition-recombination evidence and a reference-convention table that identifies every conversion required before combining datasets.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.
